hints.title: Monthly Credited Income Sums
hints.text: Filter transactions for deposit type and sum amounts grouped by account and formatted year-month date.

hints.title: Filtering Accounts Exceeding Limits
hints.text: Join with the accounts table to identify months where total credited deposit strictly exceeds max_income.

hints.title: Consecutive Month Detection
hints.text: Use the lag or lead window function on month date values to check for two or more consecutive suspicious months.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH MonthlyIncome AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.day, '%Y%m') AS ym,
        PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(t.day, '%Y%m'), '202001') AS m_num,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_income,
        a.max_income
    FROM Transactions t
    JOIN Accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'Credited'
    GROUP BY t.account_id, DATE_FORMAT(t.day, '%Y%m'), PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(t.day, '%Y%m'), '202001'), a.max_income
    HAVING total_income > a.max_income
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        m_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY m_num) AS grp
    FROM MonthlyIncome
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM Ranked
GROUP BY account_id, grp
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY account_id ASC;
```

complexity.time: O(T log T) for grouping and window partitioning
complexity.notes: Consecutive month grouping via PERIOD_DIFF and ROW_NUMBER.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-joins comparing date strings fail when consecutive months span across calendar year boundaries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear sequence mapping simplifies month difference arithmetic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle calendar year boundaries when defining consecutive calendar months.

WITH MonthlyIncome AS (

        t.account_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.day) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.day) AS m_num,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_income,
        a.max_income
    FROM Transactions t
    JOIN Accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'Credited'
    GROUP BY t.account_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.day) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.day), a.max_income
    HAVING SUM(t.amount) > a.max_income
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        m_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY m_num) AS grp
    FROM MonthlyIncome
)

FROM Ranked
